info.title: API.SH: ManoMano
info.description: The ManoMano API from API.SH: public ManoMano data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
What ManoMano suggests while a shopper types: popular searches (with their category), matching categories (path for `category` in search) and brands (path for /manomano/v1/brand).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/manomano-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text typed so far.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: fr (manomano.fr, default), es (manomano.es), it (manomano.it) or de (manomano.de). Ids, paths and filter values come from that market's own pages.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

queries.query: perceuse visseuse perforateur burineur marteau piqueur

get.description:
A brand's products on ManoMano with the same fields, filters and sorts as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/manomano-brand

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A brand path such as makita-16 (from a product's brand url or a suggestion) or a manomano.fr/marque/ link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, rating.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum price in euros.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Maximum price in euros.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Only this brand, as the site writes it (e.g. MAKITA; a value from the brand filter).

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Minimum star rating, 1-5.

parameters.name: free_delivery
parameters.description: true for free delivery only.

parameters.name: relay_delivery
parameters.description: true for pickup-point delivery only.

parameters.name: express
parameters.description: true for ManoExpress (fast delivery) only.

parameters.name: promo
parameters.description: Only products in this promotion (a value from the promo filter, e.g. blackfriday).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: More filters as key:value pairs separated by `;`, keys and values from `filters` (e.g. cat_attr_84:Sans fil;cat_attr_14:18; ranges as min-max).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: fr (manomano.fr, default), es (manomano.es), it (manomano.it) or de (manomano.de). Ids, paths and filter values come from that market's own pages.

get.description:
One ManoMano product: ids, title, EAN, manufacturer and seller references, brand, price with and without VAT, price before discount, eco fee, seller (with link), how many other sellers offer it, promotion, description, all attributes, images, documents, category path, rating with its star breakdown, the top reviews, questions and answers, and the buying guide.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/manomano-product

parameters.description: Market: fr (manomano.fr, default), es (manomano.es), it (manomano.it) or de (manomano.de). Ids, paths and filter values come from that market's own pages.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every customer review of a ManoMano product, newest first by default: review id, star rating, text, date, reviewer first name and country, professional-buyer flag, helpful votes, photos and the shop the review was written on. Sort by date or rating; only professional buyers; leave out reviews translated from other countries. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/manomano-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A product link, its last part (perceuse-...-14307908) or the article id at its end.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Market: fr (default), es, it or de.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the reviews.

parameters.name: pro_only
parameters.description: Only reviews from professional buyers.

parameters.name: exclude_translated
parameters.description: Leave out reviews translated from another country's shop.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-50 (default 20).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
ManoMano product search or a category listing with every filter the site offers: article id, product and model ids, title, link, brand, price and price before discount, rating and review count, seller, delivery label, images, category, promotion and its end date, sponsored flag. `filters` lists the price range, ratings, promotions, brands, delivery options and the category's technical attributes with counts (pass keys and values back). Searches that match a category are answered with that category's listing (see `category`). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/manomano-search

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
